args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to production) was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified as rolled_out.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1), with an 18% error rate across all regions.

**Actions taken:**

1. **Investigated** — Confirmed current production version was v2.3.1 (unhealthy, 18% error rate). Deployment history showed v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production; v2.3.1-rc was only staging and unhealthy.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status check confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.2%.
